title: Customer Sales Advisor
description:
Full job description

Job Title: Trainee Insurance Advisor Full Training Provided (No Experience Needed!)

Location: Taunton (Office-based)

Salary: £27,000 £35,000 (Depending on experience/growth potential)

Hours: Monday Friday, 08 00 (Plus 1 Saturday morning per month/WFH)

Kickstart Your Career in Taunton No Experience Needed!

Stuck in retail, hospitality, or sales, and looking for an office-based career with real progression and professional qualifications?

We are a close-knit, high-energy independent insurance brokerage in Taunton looking for ambitious, people-focused individuals to join our team. We don t expect you to know anything about insurance we care about your personality, drive, and communication skills, and we ll teach you the rest.

What s in It for You?
- Earn While You Learn: A competitive starting salary of £27,000 £35,000, with clear milestones for pay increases.
- Fully Funded Professional Qualifications: We pay for you to gain your Cert CII (Chartered Insurance Institute) professional credentials, boosting your market value.
- Real Career Progression: This isn't just a phone job. You ll get a 360-degree understanding of personal lines, commercial insurance, and client management.
- Solid Work-Life Balance: Standard Monday to Friday hours (with just one Saturday shift a month) so you still have your weekends.
- Great Team Culture: Work in a supportive, friendly environment where your wins are actually celebrated (no corporate micromanagement here).

What You ll Be Doing:
- Talking to clients every day, building genuine rapport, and finding the right insurance policies to protect what matters to them.
- Guiding customers through quotes, renewals, and policy updates over the phone and via email.
- Keeping accurate digital records and managing client portfolios with attention to detail.
- Collaborating with the team to hit collective milestones and earn bonus/incentive rewards.

About You:
- People Person: You re confident, chatty, and naturally good at building trust with anyone.
- Ambitious & Driven: You want a long-term professional career path, not just a stepping-stone job.
- Organised & Tech-Savvy: Comfortable navigating computer systems and keeping track of details.
- Ready to Learn: Willing to study for professional qualifications (good GCSEs, including Maths, are helpful here!).

Ready to start your next chapter? Hit 'Apply Now' and let s chat.

Cowell Recruitment Ltd is an equal opportunities recruitment agency. Only candidates with the Right to Work (RTW) in the UK can be considered.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Development Sales Manager (Sales Advisor)

South-West region, Weston-Super-Mare

Competitive salary + attractive benefits

At Miller Homes we are building homes in a way which allows us to build better places for people to belong to, better homes for customers and better places for communities to thrive and nature to prosper. We are also creating a better working environment for our people. We create better places where people and planet prosper.

We are looking to recruit a Development Sales Manager (Sales Advisor) to join our fantastic South West region, ideally based around the Weston-Super-Mare region. The role will see you take responsibility for and manage the development sales function and be the primary Miller Homes contact for potential and existing customers. Having responsibility for securing the sale of homes and managing the customer journey in accordance with company standards, procedures and targets.

SALES ADVISOR RESPONSIBILITIES:
- To manage and control the Development sales function from pre-start to post completion
- Meet prospective customers and maintain primary point of contact throughout customer journey
- Manage the requirements and expectations of customers throughout the house buying process,
- Take responsibility for the development s presentation and ensure it reflects a strong sales message and the highest of standards

SALES ADVISOR REQUIREMENTS:
- Experience of high-performance in a Sales role
- A presentable, customer-facing professional with experience of dealing with customers and providing an exceptional standard of customer service
- Experienced in problem solving and the ability to analyse/report on issues that could affect the development
- Able to rapidly assimilate and assess situations and issues, offering solutions with maximum results

WHAT WE OFFER:
- Competitive basic salary
- 26 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off
- Excellent commission structure
- Company contribute 6.5% to your pension, plus other benefits
